services.desc: Southern Exposure Inshore Fishing makes it easy to enjoy a day on the beautiful Alabama waters. When you book your fishing trip, we'll decide the best place to go based upon what you want to do, the fish you want to catch, and the time that we'll go out. After that, you just need to meet Capt Chris at the launch and we'll take care of the rest! Also, if you are visiting the area, we are glad to give recommendations for accommodations Throughout my life I have had the opportunity to experience many different types of boats and the Panga is hands down my favorite.
